entries.en: Did you hear about Alice? She sure got over her father in a hurry.
entries.ro: Ai auzit de Alice? S-a consolat repede după tatăl ei.

entries.en: Well, my dear, she never did like him much.
entries.ro: Păi, dragă, nici nu-l prea plăcea.

entries.en: Nobody liked old Rhyne much. But he was her father.
entries.ro: Nu prea-l plăcea nimeni pe bătrânul Rhyne. Dar era tatăl ei.

entries.en: Speaking of which, what a story. I mean, a heart attack?
Right? There he was, the mayor, without proper care. A scandal in itself.
entries.ro: Nu? Primarul, acolo, fără îngrijire cum trebuie. Scandal, mamă!
